2026_04_DEN_SF.headline: Nix and Denver’s secondary challenge Purdy’s unbeaten 49ers in Santa Clara
2026_04_DEN_SF.paragraph1: Bo Nix brings Denver into Santa Clara after consecutive comeback wins, with Sean Payton’s offense needing efficient early-down execution against unbeaten San Francisco. Brock Purdy threw four touchdowns against Arizona, while George Kittle has helped stabilize a 49ers offense managing injuries around him. Denver’s clearest defensive lever is Pat Surtain II limiting explosive completions and forcing longer drives; San Francisco can answer by protecting Purdy and distributing the ball before Denver’s rush can dictate the down.
2026_04_DEN_SF.model_rationale: Denver needs efficient early-down offense and disciplined coverage to keep San Francisco from controlling tempo, while the hosts can stress the Broncos by protecting Purdy and distributing targets.
